summary: Dark / light mode toggle for the web app
description: The site follows the operating system's colour scheme today, with no way to change it. Add a theme toggle so visitors can choose light, dark or system, and make every page honour the choice.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: A theme toggle with three options (light, dark, system) is visible on every page and is keyboard accessible with an accessible name.
AC2: Choosing light or dark overrides the OS preference on every page (chat, /catalog, /pipeline), including all existing Tailwind dark: styles; system follows prefers-color-scheme.
AC3: The choice persists in localStorage across reloads and visits, and the page renders in the chosen theme on first paint with no flash of the wrong theme.
AC4: Unit tests cover theme resolution (stored choice vs system preference) and persisting the choice.
guidance: Tailwind v4: switch the dark variant to a class or data attribute with @custom-variant in globals.css, and move the prefers-color-scheme block in globals.css to the same mechanism.
Avoid the flash with a small inline script in the root layout that sets the theme before hydration; no new dependency such as next-themes.
Keep the existing colours; this card adds control, not a redesign. Do not touch the Go server.
